primary_outcome: final feasible_mean_nonroot_loss after the last update within the fixed budget
primary_comparison: pev minus nonleaf_coverage_ens, paired by seed
analysis: Twenty paired independently drawn coefficient systems on one fixed graph template. Report every seed-level primary difference, its mean, 95% paired-system confidence interval, and two-sided paired test. No best-checkpoint selection or seed dropping. A primary improvement claim requires lower error with a confidence interval excluding zero. The naive-variance comparison is secondary; a tie precludes attribution to the integrated-variance formula. Treat the earlier hom30/hetero30 confirmations as separate studies unless a combined multiplicity plan is declared before analysis.
validation: Each of 80 cells must have schema-v3 source-pinned receipt, matching system hash across all four arms per seed, exact 2000 environment samples, finite final noisy and noise-free metrics, and zero candidate-probe samples. Failed cells are repaired before reading aggregate results. Pull complete artifacts locally and verify CURC/local file checksums.
scope: Known fully observed DAG, fixed hierarchical topology, independent coefficient draws and shifted function forms. This is synthetic function-family transfer, not independent graph-topology or external-domain validation. No closed-source model calls.
